# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }} Mobconverge is a boutique software engineering practice led by Mark Schisler, Principal, based in St. Louis, Missouri and working with clients across the United States.

We partner with founders and teams to design, build, and ship native mobile and web products — bringing the craft and care of a dedicated engineering partner to every line of code. Work is delivered test-first, using Extreme Programming, Lean, and Test-Driven Development practices. Clients own the code outright.
